resources.string: Estimates vertical swipe activity inside Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok feeds. DOOMLY never reads, stores, or transmits screen text, usernames, comments, or messages (canRetrieveWindowContent is disabled). Everything stays 100% local on your phone.
These labels are playful awareness indicators, not medical or scientific assessments.

Android cannot directly count the exact number of Reels, Shorts, or TikTok videos viewed. DOOMLY estimates scrolls by observing vertical swipe gestures inside short-form video feeds when Accessibility permission is enabled. This number is an estimate that can be slightly off and may change when Instagram, YouTube, or TikTok update their apps.
